title: Inside vehicle-to-grid energy exchange
intro: Explore the components involved in coordinating an electric vehicle, a home and the distribution grid. This is a conceptual illustration.

home.label: Home energy demand
home.detail: The home represents local electricity demand. Coordinated charging considers that demand alongside the vehicle’s energy needs.

ev.label: Bidirectional EV charging
ev.detail: A bidirectional charger enables an appropriately equipped vehicle to receive energy or return it to a connected electrical system. Dispatch remains subject to vehicle, charger and operating limits.

grid.label: Distribution grid
grid.detail: The grid connection represents electricity exchange with the wider network. This schematic does not reproduce an experimental feeder.
